title: Creatifact request file
description: Describes one Creatifact command (or a `steps` pipeline) to run via `creatifact -f <file>.json`. Single-command form: the 'command' field selects the command; the remaining fields map to its arguments, and command-line flags after the file override generate.* fields. Pipeline form: a `steps` array runs sequentially, fails fast, and resolves `${step.field}` references to earlier steps' results (tag/digest/outputDir/artifacts[N].url).

steps.description: Pipeline form: steps run sequentially; each step is a single-command object plus an optional `name` used in `${name.field}` references.

name.description: Step name for ${name.field} references; must be unique.

provider.description: Provider id, optionally with model: 'zhipu' or 'zhipu/cogview-4'. Omit to use the default provider (config key defaults.gen.provider).

prompt.description: Text instruction or question (generate.text2text / text2image / image2image / text2video / image2video / frames2video; optional for image2text / video2text).

images.description: Reference image(s): http(s)/data URL, local path, or pkg://path into a recipe package. Repeatable as --image. Exactly one for image2image and image2video.

inputs.description: Media attachments (generate.image2text / video2text) or texts to embed (generate.embed). Repeatable as --input.

noWait.description: Video tasks only: submit and print the task handle without polling.

timeout.description: Video tasks and resume: polling timeout, duration string (e.g. "5m") or milliseconds.

interval.description: Video tasks and resume: polling interval, duration string (e.g. "5s") or milliseconds.

output.description: Media tasks: result OCI layout directory. Resume / --no-pack: directory to save artifacts. Also used by build / pull.

tag.description: Media tasks only: reference name for the result package (default gen-output:latest). Also build's image reference.

noPack.description: Media tasks only: print artifacts without building a result package.

handle.description: generate.resume only: the saved task handle (object or inline JSON string).

dir.description: build only: local directory packed as the top layer.

ref.description: push / pull only: registry reference, e.g. localhost:5000/myrepo:1.0.

plainHttp.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS for the registry.

key.description: config.get / config.set only: dotted config key.

value.description: config.set only: the value to store (typed JSON).
